subjects.subject_daily_intro: Today, we will be diving into the world of inequalities and their graphs. This is an important concept that will help you understand how to represent constraints in mathematical expressions.
subjects.subject_topic_daily_summary: By the end of today, you will be able to write and graph linear inequalities, identifying the shaded regions that represent solutions.

subjects.subject_daily_intro: Today, we'll explore constellations, which are important markers in the night sky. There are many interesting stories and history behind these patterns of stars.
subjects.subject_topic_daily_summary: You will learn about major constellations, their historical significance, and how to locate them in the night sky.

subjects.subject_daily_intro: Today’s focus will be on variables and data types, which are fundamental concepts in programming that you will use to create effective code.
subjects.subject_topic_daily_summary: By the end of the day, you will dominate the topics of data types and variables, understanding how to declare and use them in coding.

subjects.subject_daily_intro: In English today, we will study plot structure, which is crucial for understanding how stories are built and how plots unfold.
subjects.subject_topic_daily_summary: You will gain a comprehensive understanding of plot structure, including its various elements and stages.

subjects.subject_daily_intro: We are going to explore atoms and molecules today, which are the building blocks of matter. This is essential knowledge for understanding chemistry.
subjects.subject_topic_daily_summary: By the end of today, you will understand the basic structure of atoms, the difference between elements and compounds, and how molecules form.

subjects.subject_daily_intro: Today, we will learn about the Spanish missions and settlements in Texas, which played a significant role in its history.
subjects.subject_topic_daily_summary: You will learn about the significance of Spanish missions in Texas and their overall impact on Texas history.

subjects.subject_daily_intro: Yesterday we introduced inequalities. Today, we will practice graphing linear inequalities with more complex examples.
